docs.title:
Relay For The Win

Relay FTW is a high-performance communication tool designed for the heat of the game. It allows coaches to broadcast instant messages to players directly on the field using seamless Bluetooth technology. Whether you need to organize your strategy with custom tabs, message specific player groups, or send a "single-shot" alert, Relay FTW ensures your team stays synchronized in real-time.
Requirements
docs.text: To ensure a high-performance experience with Relay FTW, your hardware must meet the following specifications for seamless Bluetooth communication.

docs.title: 1. Mobile Device
docs.text:
The Relay FTW coach's interface runs on Android-powered devices. You can use either a smartphone or a tablet, provided they meet these criteria:

Operating System: Android 8.0 (Oreo) or higher.

Bluetooth: Must support Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to maintain a stable connection with player devices on the field.

Form Factor: While tablets offer a larger canvas for managing multiple player tabs, the mobile app is fully optimized for one-handed use on smartphones.

docs.title: 2. Wearable Device (Players)
docs.text:
Players receive real-time signals via smartwatches. For the "Relay" system to function, the wearable hardware must be compatible with modern standards:

Software: Must support Wear OS 3.0 or greater.

Compatibility Note: Older watches running Tizen OS, such as the Samsung Galaxy Watch 3 or older, are not supported.

Recommended Hardware: Galaxy Watch 4, 5, 6, 7, and Pixel Watch series.

docs.title: Supported Hardware List
docs.text:
For a detailed list of verified devices and specific model compatibility, please visit our dedicated hardware page:

View Supported Watches & Devices.

docs.title: Supported Watches & Devices
docs.text:
Relay FTW requires hardware running Wear OS 3.0 or greater. This version of Wear OS allows for the high-performance Bluetooth communication required to relay signals instantly on the field.

Critical Compatibility Note

The Samsung Galaxy Watch 3 and older models (Watch Active 2, Gear S3) run on "Tizen OS" and are NOT supported by Relay FTW.

docs.title: Samsung Galaxy Series
docs.text:
Samsung is our most recommended hardware for durability on the field.

  • Galaxy Watch 7 / Ultra
  • Galaxy Watch 6 & 6 Classic
  • Galaxy Watch 5 & 5 Pro
  • Galaxy Watch 4 & 4 Classic
  • Galaxy Watch FE

docs.title: Google Pixel Series
docs.text:
Known for excellent haptic feedback (vibrations), which helps players feel signals during loud games.

  • Pixel Watch 3
  • Pixel Watch 2
  • Pixel Watch (Original)

docs.title: Other Verified Models
docs.text:
• OnePlus Watch 2 (Excellent battery life for long tournaments)
  • Mobvoi TicWatch Pro 5
  • Xiaomi Watch 2 / Pro

docs.title: Unsupported Hardware
docs.text:
These devices do not have the software architecture required to run the Relay FTW receiver app.

  • All Apple Watches (iOS is not compatible)
  • Samsung Galaxy Watch 3 and older (Tizen OS)
  • Garmin / Fitbit Devices
  • Fossil Gen 5 and older

docs.title: Battery Management
docs.text: For long tournament days, we recommend the Galaxy Watch 5 Pro or Galaxy Watch Ultra. They offer the best battery life for constant Bluetooth use.
